evidence.quote: This interface preserves quantitative expression signal while allowing natural-language instructions, explicit gene mentions, and multiple interleaved biological samples to be processed together in one model context.

representation_rationale.summary: The compact continuous representation preserves quantitative expression information.

evidence.quote: Crucially, this architecture supports the interleaving of multiple expression profiles within a single context window, empowering the model to perform direct comparative analyses across samples.

representation_rationale.summary: The representation supports multi-sample comparative reasoning within one prompt.

evidence.quote: While compatible with unmodified LLMs [OpenAI, 2023, Touvron et al., 2023], these representations rapidly saturate context windows on full transcriptomes that span tens of thousands of expressed genes and discard the quantitative expression magnitudes that rank-only orderings cannot convey, forcing aggressive truncation of low-abundance transcripts.

representation_rationale.summary: The authors criticize text serialization because it consumes context and loses expression magnitudes.

evidence.quote: Encoding our 19,260 gene panel with the unmodified Qwen3 tokenizer requires on average 3 . 74 subword tokens per gene symbol, so collapsing each name to a single token can substantially shorten prompts and target sequences for tasks that mention many genes.

representation_rationale.summary: Explicit gene tokens reduce the token cost of gene names.
